subheadline.en: Research Scientist working on 3D Geometry, Sensor Fusion, and AI Wearables

en.text: Led multimodal perception for AI glasses and EMG Wearables at Meta Reality Labs
Experienced in real-time motion tracking and gesture recognition for wearable devices
PhD in Computer Science from the University of Toronto on 3D graphics and creation in AR/VR
Research portfolio spanning product prototyping, multimodal AI, user studies, 3D graphics systems, and computational design
